_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — calculation business shape. Preserves the load-bearing calc structure 9.3 compares: labor/material/subcontractor/machinery/other rows, fractional quantity, a per-row margin (cost/sell öre), notes, the hidden-row flag (is_hidden), and option/tillval selection (is_optional/is_selected). The INCLUSION pin (2026-06-18): a selected option + a hidden row COUNT toward totals; an unselected option does NOT. readinessWarnings pins ONLY real ReadinessCode union members (LOW_MARGIN / HIDDEN_ROWS_INCLUDED / MISSING_WORK_ROLE) — NEVER the fictional REQUIRES_SIGN_OFF/DEDUCTION_ESTIMATE_UNAPPROVED (R-903). ZERO PII (money/öre/flags only). Every öre integer < 10 digits (orgnr-scan safe). Öre are representative calc rows for this comparison category — the money-golden fixtures stay the single numeric authority for the pure engine (this fixture is a SHAPE oracle, not a re-pin of an engine result).
